title: Lensium
tagline: Decentralized Web3 Blog Dapp built on Lens protocol
description: pay as you read A decentralized blogging platform that allows reader to pay for the blogs that you read not the whole subscription fees. For Example I as a writer is writing 10 blogs per month and the reader only want's to read 2 blogs per month so he/she can be charge for that two blogs, not the whole subscription.
